workout/v1.1.0/workout.straight.example..en: Three identical sets. The baseline everything else departs from.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.straight.example..translation: Tri identične serije. Osnova od koje sve ostalo polazi.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.ramping.example.j.en: Ascending load across five sets to a top set.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.ramping.example.j.translation: Rastuće opterećenje kroz pet serija do vršne serije.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.reverse-pyramid.e.en: Heaviest set first, dropping 10% each set as fatigue accumulates.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.reverse-pyramid.e.translation: Najteža serija prva, uz pad od 10% po seriji kako se umor gomila.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.drop-sets.example.en: Three consecutive drops with no rest, taken to technical failure.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.drop-sets.example.translation: Tri uzastopna spuštanja opterećenja bez odmora, izvedena do tehničkog otkaza.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.rest-pause.exampl.en: One set to near-failure, resumed after 15-second rests.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.rest-pause.exampl.translation: Jedna serija do blizu otkaza, nastavljana posle odmora od po 15 sekundi.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.cluster.example.j.en: Reps in pairs with programmed rest *inside* the set, so heavy load stays fast.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.cluster.example.j.translation: Ponavljanja u parovima sa programiranim odmorom *unutar* serije, tako da teško opterećenje ostaje brzo.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.myo-reps.example..en: An activation set followed by four short mini-sets at RIR 1.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.myo-reps.example..translation: Aktivaciona serija praćena sa četiri kratke mini-serije na RIR 1.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.amrap-reps.exampl.en: A single set of as many reps as possible, with a floor and a cap — AMRAP as a *rep target*, distinct from an AMRAP block.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.amrap-reps.exampl.translation: Jedna serija sa što više ponavljanja, sa donjom i gornjom granicom — AMRAP kao *ciljni broj ponavljanja*, različit od AMRAP bloka.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.top-set-backoff.e.en: One heavy top set at RPE 8, then three back-offs 10% lighter.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.top-set-backoff.e.translation: Jedna teška vršna serija na RPE 8, zatim tri back-off serije lakše za 10%.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.wave-loading.exam.en: A 3‑2‑1 rep ladder run three times at the same load.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.wave-loading.exam.translation: Lestvica ponavljanja 3‑2‑1 izvedena tri puta sa istim opterećenjem.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.density.example.j.en: Maximum sets inside a ten-minute cap — the one scheme where set count is the outcome, not the input.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.density.example.j.translation: Maksimalan broj serija unutar gornje granice od deset minuta — jedina šema u kojoj je broj serija ishod, a ne ulaz.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.technical-failure.en: Both failure kinds in one item: technical failure on set one, absolute failure on set two.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.technical-failure.translation: Obe vrste otkaza u jednoj stavci: tehnički otkaz u prvoj seriji, apsolutni otkaz u drugoj.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.tempo-reps.exampl.en: A four-second eccentric with an explosive concentric.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.tempo-reps.exampl.translation: Ekscentrična faza od četiri sekunde sa eksplozivnom koncentričnom.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.paused-reps.examp.en: A three-second pause at the bottom, which is `tempo.bottomPause` rather than a scheme.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.paused-reps.examp.translation: Pauza od tri sekunde u donjoj poziciji, što je `tempo.bottomPause`, a ne šema.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.partials.example..en: Full-range reps followed by bottom-half partials. Uses `repStyle` — nothing else in the model reaches range of motion.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.partials.example..translation: Ponavljanja punog obima pokreta praćena parcijalnim ponavljanjima u donjoj polovini. Koristi `repStyle` — ništa drugo u modelu ne dotiče obim pokreta.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.one-and-a-half-re.en: A full rep plus a half counted as one, via `repStyle.pattern`.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.one-and-a-half-re.translation: Celo ponavljanje plus polovina računato kao jedno, preko `repStyle.pattern`.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.isometric-holds.e.en: A hold with a floor and a cap, using `repTarget.maxHold`.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.isometric-holds.e.translation: Izdržaj sa donjom i gornjom granicom, koristeći `repTarget.maxHold`.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.timed-sets.exampl.en: 45-second efforts in a heart-rate zone — the clock terminates the set, not a rep count.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.timed-sets.exampl.translation: Napori od 45 sekundi u zoni srčane frekvencije — seriju prekida sat, a ne broj ponavljanja.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.superset.example..en: Two items alternated via `groupLabel` `A1`/`A2`, rest at the group boundary.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.superset.example..translation: Dve stavke koje se smenjuju preko `groupLabel` `A1`/`A2`, odmor na granici grupe.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.giant-set.example.en: Four items in one group. Nothing in the schema caps group size.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.giant-set.example.translation: Četiri stavke u jednoj grupi. Ništa u šemi ne ograničava veličinu grupe.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.compound-set.exam.en: Two items training the same muscle. **Structurally identical to the antagonist pairing below** — see RFC-007 §3.3 for why that is deliberate.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.compound-set.exam.translation: Dve stavke koje treniraju isti mišić. **Strukturno identično uparivanju antagonista ispod** — pogledajte RFC-007 §3.3 za razlog zašto je to namerno.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.antagonist-pairin.en: Two items training opposing muscles. The difference from a compound set is derivable from the exercises, not encoded here.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.antagonist-pairin.translation: Dve stavke koje treniraju suprotstavljene mišiće. Razlika u odnosu na kombinovanu seriju izvodi se iz vežbi, a ne kodira se ovde.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.barbell-complex.e.en: One barbell, one load, four movements, no rest until the round ends.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.barbell-complex.e.translation: Jedna šipka, jedno opterećenje, četiri pokreta, bez odmora dok se krug ne završi.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.circuit.example.j.en: One set of each item per round, four rounds, rest between rounds.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.circuit.example.j.translation: Po jedna serija svake stavke po krugu, četiri kruga, odmor između krugova.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.emom.example.json.en: Every minute on the minute for twelve intervals.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.emom.example.json.translation: Rad na početku svakog minuta, tokom dvanaest intervala.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.amrap-block.examp.en: As many rounds as possible in twenty minutes — AMRAP as a *block mode*, distinct from the rep target above.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.amrap-block.examp.translation: Što više krugova u dvadeset minuta — AMRAP kao *režim bloka*, različit od ciljnog broja ponavljanja iznad.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.for-time.example..en: Fixed work completed as fast as possible, under a cap.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.for-time.example..translation: Zadati rad završen što je brže moguće, uz gornju vremensku granicu.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.chipper.example.j.en: One descending pass through five movements, each finished before the next.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.chipper.example.j.translation: Jedan opadajući prolaz kroz pet pokreta, svaki završen pre sledećeg.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.tabata.example.js.en: Eight rounds of 20 seconds work, 10 seconds rest.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.tabata.example.js.translation: Osam krugova od 20 sekundi rada i 10 sekundi odmora.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.ladder-circuit.ex.en: A scheme and a mode composing: ladder rungs *inside* a circuit.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.ladder-circuit.ex.translation: Šema i režim u kompoziciji: prečke lestvice *unutar* kružnog treninga.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.warmup-block.exam.en: A `warmup` block preceding the working block, in one session.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.warmup-block.exam.translation: Blok `warmup` koji prethodi radnom bloku, u jednom treningu.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.cooldown-block.ex.en: Zone-1 work followed by a `cooldown` block of holds.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.cooldown-block.ex.translation: Rad u zoni 1 praćen blokom `cooldown` sa izdržajima.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.finisher.example..en: A working block plus a four-minute `finisher` taken to technical failure.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.finisher.example..translation: Radni blok plus četvorominutni `finisher` izveden do tehničkog otkaza.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.absolute..en: A fixed load. The only method that needs no resolution context.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.absolute..translation: Fiksno opterećenje. Jedini metod kome nije potreban kontekst razrešavanja.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent1R.en: 82.5% of the prescribed exercise's own one-rep max — the percentage-driven program case.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent1R.translation: 82.5% maksimuma za jedno ponavljanje same propisane vežbe — slučaj programa vođenog procentima.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent-b.en: 60% of bodyweight. Unresolvable inside FDS by design — there is no athlete to read a bodyweight from.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent-b.translation: 60% telesne mase. Nerazrešivo unutar FDS-a po dizajnu — ne postoji sportista od koga bi se očitala telesna masa.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.rpe.examp.en: RPE 8 with half-points allowed. The athlete picks the load.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.rpe.examp.translation: RPE 8 sa dozvoljenim polovinama poena. Sportista bira opterećenje.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.rir.examp.en: Two reps in reserve. The inverse scale to RPE; a bare `count` cannot tell you which was meant, which is why they are separate methods.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.rir.examp.translation: Dva ponavljanja u rezervi. Obrnuta skala u odnosu na RPE; goli `count` ne može reći na koju se mislilo, i zato su ovo odvojeni metodi.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.velocity-.en: Velocity-based training: lift at 0.75 m/s, end the set when bar speed has dropped 20% from the fastest rep. The set length is decided by the bar, not the program.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.velocity-.translation: Trening zasnovan na brzini: podizanje na 0.75 m/s, serija se završava kada brzina šipke padne 20% u odnosu na najbrže ponavljanje. Dužinu serije određuje šipka, a ne program.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.machine-l.en: A machine setting, with `scale` naming whose numbering it is. Reproduces a session on *that* machine and means nothing on another.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.machine-l.translation: Podešavanje sprave, gde `scale` imenuje čija je numeracija. Reprodukuje trening na *toj* spravi, a na drugoj ne znači ništa.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.band-resi.en: A green band with an estimated equivalent load. Colour conventions are manufacturer-specific, so `equipment` says whose scale is meant and `estimatedLoad` is explicitly an approximation.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.band-resi.translation: Zelena elastična traka sa procenjenim ekvivalentnim opterećenjem. Konvencije boja zavise od proizvođača, pa `equipment` kaže na čiju se skalu misli, a `estimatedLoad` je izričito aproksimacija.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.autoregul.en: Load deferred to a progression rule resolved at execution time (here, APRE).
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.autoregul.translation: Opterećenje prepušteno pravilu progresije koje se razrešava u vreme izvršavanja (ovde APRE).

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.en: Last session plus 2.5 kg. Linear progression, resolvable only against training history.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.translation: Prošli trening plus 2.5 kg. Linearna progresija, razrešiva samo u odnosu na istoriju treninga.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.en: Ten percent *below* an estimated 1RM for a named lift. A negative delta is normal here: e1RM is computed from a set taken near failure, so programming under it is the usual case, not an error.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.translation: Deset procenata *ispod* procenjenog 1RM za imenovanu vežbu. Negativna delta je ovde normalna: e1RM se izračunava iz serije izvedene blizu otkaza, pa je programiranje ispod njega uobičajen slučaj, a ne greška.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.en: 90% of a training max — the 5/3/1-style basis, where the reference is deliberately below a true max.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.relative-.translation: 90% trenažnog maksimuma — osnova u stilu 5/3/1, gde je referenca namerno ispod pravog maksimuma.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent1R.en: 70% of a *different* lift's max. Accessory work is routinely scaled off a main lift, and without `referenceExerciseId` there is nowhere to say so.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.percent1R.translation: 70% maksimuma *druge* vežbe. Pomoćni rad se rutinski skalira prema glavnoj vežbi, a bez `referenceExerciseId` nema gde to da se kaže.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.bodyweigh.translation: Telesna masa, bez skaliranja i bez dodatnog opterećenja.

prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.assisted..en: 20 kg of *assistance*. The value is positive and more of it is less effort — a consumer plotting this as resistance shows an athlete regressing as they get stronger.
prescription/v1.0.0/loadTarget.assisted..translation: 20 kg *asistencije*. Vrednost je pozitivna i više nje znači manje napora — konzument koji ovo ucrta kao otpor prikazuje sportistu koji nazaduje dok postaje jači.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.duration.example..en: Thirty minutes in a heart-rate zone. The clock terminates the effort, and no rep count is invented to stand in for one.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.duration.example..translation: Trideset minuta u zoni srčane frekvencije. Napor prekida sat, i nikakav broj ponavljanja se ne izmišlja da ga zameni.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.distance.example..en: Five kilometres. Distance terminates the effort, so duration is the outcome rather than the prescription.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.distance.example..translation: Pet kilometara. Napor prekida distanca, pa je trajanje ishod, a ne preskripcija.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.pace.example.json.en: Distance says how far, zone says how fast. Note that a *higher* pace zone means a *lower* time per kilometre — the one place zone ordering and the underlying number run in opposite directions.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.pace.example.json.translation: Distanca kaže koliko daleko, zona kaže koliko brzo. Imajte u vidu da *viša* zona tempa kretanja znači *manje* vreme po kilometru — jedino mesto gde redosled zona i broj iza njega idu u suprotnim smerovima.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.hr-zone.example.j.en: `boundsRef` names the registry entry that defines Z2. The athlete's beats per minute are caller context and never appear here.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.hr-zone.example.j.translation: `boundsRef` imenuje unos u registru koji definiše Z2. Otkucaji u minuti sportiste su kontekst pozivaoca i nikada se ne pojavljuju ovde.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.power-zone.exampl.en: Sweet-spot intervals against the Coggan seven-zone model. What percentage of threshold power a zone corresponds to belongs to the registry entry, not to the session.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.power-zone.exampl.translation: Sweet-spot intervali prema Cogganovom modelu sa sedam zona. Kom procentu snage na pragu zona odgovara pripada unosu u registru, a ne treningu.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.structured-interv.en: The canonical 4×4. Work and rest live in `modeParams` because they are properties of the interval structure, not of the exercise performed inside it.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.structured-interv.translation: Kanonski 4×4. Rad i odmor žive u `modeParams` jer su svojstva strukture intervala, a ne vežbe koja se u njoj izvodi.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.fartlek.example.j.en: Deliberately unstructured surges. `sequential` rather than `interval` precisely because the surge lengths are the athlete's — it looks like intervals and is not.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.fartlek.example.j.translation: Namerno nestrukturirana ubrzanja. `sequential` umesto `interval` upravo zato što dužine ubrzanja pripadaju sportisti — liči na intervale, a nije.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.machine-settings..en: Incline climbing per set, then cadence with a tolerance band. Shows the 1.1.0 additions doing the work they exist for, and shows the division: resistance is a *load* (`loadTarget.method: "level"` with a named scale), incline and cadence are *settings* the athlete dials in.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.machine-settings..translation: Nagib raste po seriji, zatim kadenca sa opsegom tolerancije. Prikazuje dodatke iz 1.1.0 kako rade posao zbog koga postoje, i prikazuje podelu: otpor je *opterećenje* (`loadTarget.method: "level"` sa imenovanom skalom), a nagib i kadenca su *podešavanja* koja sportista namešta.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.negative-splits.e.en: Two halves with ascending pace zones. The relationship between them *is* the session, so it is expressed as two items rather than one item with a note.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.negative-splits.e.translation: Dve polovine sa rastućim zonama tempa kretanja. Odnos među njima *jeste* trening, pa je izražen kao dve stavke, a ne kao jedna stavka sa napomenom.

workout/v1.1.0/workout.progressive.examp.en: Intensity climbing every five minutes and never coming back down. Each step is its own **item** rather than its own set, because `zone` sits on an item and not on a set.
workout/v1.1.0/workout.progressive.examp.translation: Intenzitet raste svakih pet minuta i nikada se ne vraća dole. Svaki korak je zasebna **stavka**, a ne zasebna serija, jer `zone` stoji na stavci, a ne na seriji.

prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.fixed.examp.en: Three minutes between sets. The baseline the other four depart from.
prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.fixed.examp.translation: Tri minuta između serija. Osnova od koje ostala četiri metoda polaze.

prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.to-heart-ra.en: Rest until heart rate falls to 120 bpm — needs live data at execution time.
prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.to-heart-ra.translation: Odmor dok srčana frekvencija ne padne na 120 bpm — zahteva podatke uživo u vreme izvršavanja.

prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.as-needed.e.en: Athlete's discretion, stated rather than omitted.
prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.as-needed.e.translation: Po proceni sportiste, navedeno umesto izostavljeno.

prescription/v1.0.0/restSpec.work-to-res.en: 1:2, resolved against the work interval's duration.

prescription/v1.0.0/restScope.set.exampl.en: The scope value on its own — between sets of one exercise.
prescription/v1.0.0/restScope.set.exampl.translation: Vrednost obuhvata sama za sebe — između serija jedne vežbe.

prescription/v1.0.0/restScope.group.exam.en: Between the members of a group, where the rest is a transition rather than a recovery.
prescription/v1.0.0/restScope.group.exam.translation: Između članova grupe, gde je odmor prelaz, a ne oporavak.

program/v1.0.0/program.linear.example.js.en: The whole methodology in one `progressionRule`: add load whenever every rep is completed. Both weeks are identical — the load moves, the plan does not.
program/v1.0.0/program.linear.example.js.translation: Cela metodologija u jednom `progressionRule`: dodaj opterećenje kad god su sva ponavljanja završena. Obe nedelje su identične — opterećenje se pomera, plan ne.

program/v1.0.0/program.daily-undulating..en: Three rep ranges across one week, expressed by scheduling three different sessions. The undulation is in the workouts; the program says only which falls on which day.
program/v1.0.0/program.daily-undulating..translation: Tri opsega ponavljanja u jednoj nedelji, izražena raspoređivanjem tri različita treninga. Undulacija je u treninzima; program kaže samo koji pada na koji dan.

program/v1.0.0/program.weekly-undulating.en: The same two sessions for three weeks, undulated entirely by `overrides.loadScaling` — medium, heavy, light. The workouts stay reusable because nothing was edited into them.
program/v1.0.0/program.weekly-undulating.translation: Ista dva treninga tokom tri nedelje, undulirana isključivo kroz `overrides.loadScaling` — srednje, teško, lako. Treninzi ostaju ponovo upotrebljivi jer ništa nije menjano u njima.

program/v1.0.0/program.conjugate.example.en: Rotating max-effort lifts. Rotation is a different `workout` reference each week, which is why no field for it exists.
program/v1.0.0/program.conjugate.example.translation: Rotacija vežbi maksimalnog napora. Rotacija je druga `workout` referenca svake nedelje, zbog čega polje za nju ne postoji.

program/v1.0.0/program.percentage-waves..en: 5/3/1-style waves. Two `trainingMaxes` slots declare which lifts the plan is computed from and how; `overrides.progressionState` carries the wave number. **No training-max value appears** — see RFC-008 §8.1.
program/v1.0.0/program.percentage-waves..translation: Talasi u stilu 5/3/1. Dva `trainingMaxes` slota deklarišu iz kojih se vežbi plan izračunava i kako; `overrides.progressionState` nosi broj talasa. **Nijedna vrednost trenažnog maksimuma se ne pojavljuje** — pogledajte RFC-008 §8.1.

program/v1.0.0/program.deload-weeks.exam.en: `week.deload` on week four while the cycle `intent` stays `accumulation`. That combination is the reason `deload` is a week flag and not an intent value.
program/v1.0.0/program.deload-weeks.exam.translation: `week.deload` na četvrtoj nedelji dok `intent` ciklusa ostaje `accumulation`. Ta kombinacija je razlog zašto je `deload` oznaka nedelje, a ne vrednost namere.

program/v1.0.0/program.double-progressio.en: Reps first, then load: one rule whose trigger is `topOfRepRange`, with `progressionState` tracking where in the rep range each occurrence sits.
program/v1.0.0/program.double-progressio.translation: Prvo ponavljanja, pa opterećenje: jedno pravilo čiji je okidač `topOfRepRange`, dok `progressionState` prati gde se u opsegu ponavljanja svako pojavljivanje nalazi.

program/v1.0.0/program.test-weeks.exampl.en: A test week is an ordinary cycle whose `intent` is `test`. The `retest` action updates a training-max *slot*, not a number in the document.
program/v1.0.0/program.test-weeks.exampl.translation: Test nedelja je običan ciklus čiji je `intent` `test`. Akcija `retest` ažurira *slot* trenažnog maksimuma, a ne broj u dokumentu.

program/v1.0.0/program.conditional-branc.en: Two branches off one day: repeat lighter on `failedPrescribedReps`, skip ahead on `amrapAboveThreshold`. A consumer that cannot evaluate either follows the unconditional schedule.
program/v1.0.0/program.conditional-branc.translation: Dve grane iz jednog dana: ponovi lakše na `failedPrescribedReps`, preskoči napred na `amrapAboveThreshold`. Konzument koji ne može da izračuna nijednu prati bezuslovni raspored.

program/v1.0.0/program.adaptive.example..en: Autoregulated adaptation: a fixed skeleton whose loads are decided at execution time against two declared rules. The limit of what FDS expresses — see the note below.
program/v1.0.0/program.adaptive.example..translation: Autoregulisana adaptacija: fiksni skelet čija se opterećenja određuju u vreme izvršavanja prema dva deklarisana pravila. Granica onoga što FDS izražava — pogledajte napomenu ispod.

program/v1.0.0/program.relative-offsets..en: `model: "relative"` — `offsetDays` counted from the program start, week two continuing at 7, 9, 11.
program/v1.0.0/program.relative-offsets..translation: `model: "relative"` — `offsetDays` se broji od početka programa, druga nedelja nastavlja na 7, 9, 11.

program/v1.0.0/program.rolling.example.j.en: `model: "rolling"` — three on, one off, drifting against the calendar by design. Reading this as `calendar` would collapse the rest pattern the plan is built around.
program/v1.0.0/program.rolling.example.j.translation: `model: "rolling"` — tri dana treninga, jedan odmora, uz namerno klizanje u odnosu na kalendar. Čitanje ovoga kao `calendar` urušilo bi obrazac odmora oko koga je plan izgrađen.

program/v1.0.0/program.sequence.example..en: `model: "sequence"` — neither placement field present, which is the point: `index` is the only ordering and the athlete sets the pace.
program/v1.0.0/program.sequence.example..translation: `model: "sequence"` — nijedno polje pozicioniranja nije prisutno, što i jeste poenta: `index` je jedini redosled, a sportista određuje tempo.

program/v1.0.0/program.optional-days.exa.en: `optional: true` on a conditioning day. An optional day is still a training day; the flag does not turn it into rest.
program/v1.0.0/program.optional-days.exa.translation: `optional: true` na danu kondicionog treninga. Opcioni dan je i dalje trenažni dan; oznaka ga ne pretvara u odmor.

program/v1.0.0/program.accessory-days.ex.en: Accessory work as its own optional session rather than extra blocks on a main day, so it can be dropped whole.
program/v1.0.0/program.accessory-days.ex.translation: Pomoćni rad kao zaseban opcioni trening umesto dodatnih blokova na glavnom danu, tako da može da se izostavi u celini.

program/v1.0.0/program.rest-days.example.en: All seven days stated, three of them `rest`. A prescribed rest day and an absent day are different instructions.
program/v1.0.0/program.rest-days.example.translation: Svih sedam dana navedeno, tri od njih `rest`. Propisan dan odmora i odsutan dan su različite instrukcije.
